other_conditions: The applicant must be an Indian citizen.

The applicant must be a master craftsperson who is either a National Awardee or State Awardee of exceptional standing, or possesses extraordinary skills and a significant contribution to the handicrafts sector.
The applicant must have a minimum of 20 years of experience in the craft as of 31 December of the previous year.
The applicant should have made significant contributions to the welfare and development of the craft and its community.
benefits_summary: Cash prize of ₹2 lakh along with a gold coin, shawl and Tamrapatra, plus additional financial assistance for innovation, seminars and related activities.
